items.effect: Orders and units fell three weeks running while views rose 10.7%, so the loss tracks 28 fewer video posts rather than reach.
items.action: Rebuild weekly posting toward 90 videos before adding discounts, since orders per video only fell from 0.82 to 0.68.

items.effect: The third consecutive weekly decline leaves the shop at 18.1% of the 8,444.44 week of Oct 5.
items.action: Treat this as a supply problem and restore posting volume and paid spend on Screen Door and Bidet in the same week.

items.effect: Active creators fell for a third straight week while collab invites stayed at zero, so the posting base keeps shrinking.
items.action: Re-invite creators active in the Oct 12 week who went silent in Oct 26, and resume collab invites this week.
